thread:
ravi: Quick heads-up — ran into multiple customers reacting to inconsistent 429 vs 503 in SDKs. Proposing a compact error payload that keeps HTTP semantics but adds a machine-readable 'degrade_reason' and a short 'hint' for client UX. Link: https://go/redux/err-copy :eye:

luisa: +1. We need a stable telemetry tag too (route_reason / fail_mode) so console and alerts can roll up properly. :thumbsup:

sam: Can we avoid inventing a new status class? 4xx for client-throttles, 5xx for infra. If it's a soft degrade (fallback available) use 200 with payload? that feels risky.

jess: Suggestion for client copy: "Service temporarily routing to lower-capacity model; responses may be partial. Try again or request fallback." Short and non-technical.

ravi: Here's a minimal JSON example to discuss:
```
{
  "error": "degraded_route",
  "status": 429,
  "degrade_reason": "capacity:dedicated-pool-full",
  "hint": "consider lowering batch_size or using fallback_model",
  "retry_after": 3
}
```

luisa: Love the structured fields. Add `route_id` and `model_variant` for tracing. Telemetry should emit `degrade=true` metric and increment `degrades_by_tenant`.

sam: For SDK behavior: only automatic retry when `idempotent=true` or `retry_after` present. Otherwise surface a clear Error class (DegradedRouteError) with `hint` exposed.

jess: Console UX: add a small amber 'Degraded' badge on the route card with hover text showing `reason` and last_seen timestamp. We can link to a runbook.

ravi: Rollout plan: feature-flag the new payload on canary (10% tenants) + QA synthetic load tests. Watch alerts: elevated `user-visible-errors` and client-side retry storms.

deploy-bot: deploy queued for canary flag flip at 2026-03-25 20:00 UTC — will notify when gate metrics pass.

luisa: One more: avoid leaking routing policy names to clients. Normalize `degrade_reason` values (e.g., capacity, budget, region-fallback) and keep internal ids in `route_id` only for tracing.

sam: Agreed. Also add a migration note for SDKs and docs — compact examples and table mapping old -> new behaviors.

jess: I'll draft the console copy and a compact FAQ for customers. Ping me for review. :spiral_note_pad:

ravi: thanks — will open the RFC and the canary checklist after lunch. :rocket:
